sessions.phase_label: Detailed mechanical redesign and drawing revision
Final review, correction, and file delivery

requirements.title: 3D CAD Model Delivery
requirements.definition: Provide usable 3D CAD models of the measured shaft assembly and its parts in the client-confirmed exchange and editable file formats.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers delivery and agreed formats of the 3D model; individual shaft, bushing, lug, and mandrel geometry constraints remain separate mechanical Requirements.

requirements.title: Manufacturing Drawing Set
requirements.definition: Provide a complete assembly and individual-part manufacturing drawing set in the agreed PDF and editable or export drawing formats.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the drawing-set deliverable and its file package; layout conventions and dimensional annotation correctness are independently reviewable constraints.

requirements.title: Drawing Layout and Presentation Conventions
requirements.definition: Prepare drawings using the client's supplied setup, assembly-consistent numbering, and the confirmed monochrome-versus-colored-view presentation conventions.
requirements.boundary_note: Groups closely related drafting-layout parameters; it excludes file delivery, mechanical geometry, and the correctness of dimensional callouts.

requirements.title: Drawing Dimension Annotation Accuracy
requirements.definition: Show the necessary manufacturing and functional dimensions accurately, including correct reference associations and the requested treatment of overall dimensions.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers correctness and completeness of drawing annotations rather than the underlying mechanical values, which belong to the relevant part-design Requirements.

requirements.title: ČSN/EN Standards Conformance
requirements.definition: Ensure the CAD design and manufacturing documentation meet the usual applicable ČSN/EN standards.
requirements.boundary_note: Standards conformance is independently applicable across the design and drawings and is not merely a visual drawing-template preference.

requirements.title: Main Shaft Fabrication and Machining
requirements.definition: Define the main shaft's stock, premachining, welded construction, final machining sequence, internal bore, thread, bearing-seat, and separating-groove geometry.
requirements.boundary_note: The stock, machining sequence, thread, seat, and groove are coupled parameters of one main-shaft fabrication mechanism; bushing guidance and lug geometry can evolve independently.

requirements.title: Bushing and Piston-Rod Guidance Arrangement
requirements.definition: Define how the CuSn12 bushing is located and retained relative to the main shaft, sliding end, and piston rod, including the required sliding or clearance fit and retained holes.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently evolving bushing-and-rod guidance mechanism; main-shaft fabrication, lug alignment, and material assignments remain separate.

requirements.title: Welded Lug Assembly Geometry
requirements.definition: Model the relevant ring, flange, and lug parts with the confirmed premachined-and-welded construction, angular alignment, and pre-weld face-finishing treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: Construction, angular alignment, and weld-related face preparation are tightly coupled to the lug subassembly; they can be corrected without changing the bushing mechanism.

requirements.title: Sliding Mandrel Keyway
requirements.definition: Include the required keyway groove in the sliding mandrel part.
requirements.boundary_note: The keyway is an independently testable mandrel feature with its own omission-and-correction trajectory, rather than a generic drawing-quality issue.

requirements.title: Part Material Assignments
requirements.definition: Assign S355 JRG2 to the general shaft-assembly parts and CuSn12 to the bushing, and specify those materials in the manufacturing documentation.
requirements.boundary_note: Material selection can be changed independently of part geometry and drawing presentation, so it remains a separate design Requirement.

requirements.title: Post-Close Minor Revision Support
requirements.definition: Remain available to apply small drawing or model corrections identified after the project is closed, including later production-manager feedback.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested post-delivery service obligation, not generic project administration or ordinary review activity.

unresolved_candidates.description: A final surface-finish value of 1.6 with a tolerance field is specified, but the supplied text does not identify the exact target face or part well enough to assign it safely to a Requirement.
